boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Cincinnati
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops on or immediately beside UC’s Clifton campus area, selected from direct business sources with published late hours.

cards.title: Raising Cane’s on Calhoun Street
cards.subtitle: 237 Calhoun St, beside UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Use the Calhoun Street location page to check service details before heading over; it lists dine-in hours through 3 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A Calhoun Street chicken-finger stop with 3 a.m. published hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists its 237 Calhoun Street Cincinnati restaurant as open 10 a.m.–3 a.m. daily, including dine-in service.
cards.access_notes: Published dine-in hours: 10 a.m.–3 a.m. daily; verify holiday changes on the location page.

cards.title: Shake Shack Clifton
cards.subtitle: 249 Calhoun St, beside UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Check the location page for the day’s closing time, then use its listed pickup, delivery, or dine-in options for a Calhoun Street stop.
cards.short_summary: A Clifton Shake Shack with hours to 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Shake Shack lists the Clifton location at 249 Calhoun Street open until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published store hours: until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Toppers Pizza on Calhoun
cards.subtitle: 345 Calhoun St, beside UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Use the Cincinnati entry in Toppers’ official locator to confirm the day’s window before ordering pickup or delivery from Calhoun Street.
cards.short_summary: A Calhoun Street pizza option with published hours into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Toppers lists its Cincinnati restaurant at 345 Calhoun Street open until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published Cincinnati hours: 10:30 a.m.–3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 10:30 a.m.–3:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Cinnabon on Calhoun
cards.subtitle: 271 Calhoun St, beside UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Consult the official location page for any day-specific updates; its posted schedule makes this a later dessert or snack option on Calhoun.
cards.short_summary: A Calhoun Street bakery open until 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Cinnabon lists its 271 Calhoun Street Cincinnati bakery open until 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: until 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday; until 10 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Auntie Anne’s at 271 Calhoun
cards.subtitle: 271 Calhoun St, beside UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Check the official Cincinnati listing before you go; it publishes late-evening hours and identifies the suite within the Calhoun Street address.
cards.short_summary: A pretzel counter with posted 11 p.m. hours most days.
cards.evidence_claim: Auntie Anne’s lists its Cincinnati location at 271 Calhoun Street, Suite 510B, open until 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: until 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday; until 10 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Adriatico’s UC
cards.subtitle: 113 W McMillan Ave, near UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Use Adriatico’s UC location page for dine-in and pickup timing; it distinguishes the restaurant closing time from the dine-in cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A West McMillan pizza shop with late pickup and delivery hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Adriatico’s UC lists its Cincinnati location at 113 West McMillan Avenue open until 11 p.m. Monday–Wednesday, midnight Friday–Saturday, and 10 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published closing times include 11 p.m. Monday–Wednesday and midnight Friday–Saturday; the page lists separate dine-in end times.

cards.title: Chicago Gyros & Dogs on McMillan
cards.subtitle: 201 W McMillan St, near UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s own site for the current day before walking over; it posts 10 p.m. closing Monday through Saturday and 9 p.m. Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A nearby gyro and hot-dog restaurant with published 10 p.m. weekday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Gyros & Dogs lists its Cincinnati location at 201 West McMillan Street open 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Saturday and until 9 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: until 10 p.m. Monday–Saturday; until 9 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Sichuan Palace on Calhoun
cards.subtitle: 343 Calhoun St, beside UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s official page to verify the day, especially its Tuesday closure, before planning a pickup stop on Calhoun Street.
cards.short_summary: A Calhoun Street Chinese restaurant with posted 9 p.m. service on open days.
cards.evidence_claim: Sichuan Palace lists its Cincinnati location at 343 Calhoun Street open until 9 p.m. Sunday, Monday, and Wednesday–Saturday; it is closed Tuesday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 11:30 a.m.–9 p.m. Sunday, Monday, and Wednesday–Saturday; closed Tuesday.

cards.title: Hummus Republic on Calhoun
cards.subtitle: 257 Calhoun St, beside UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Check the official Cincinnati location page for daily service status, then use its listed dine-in, pickup, or delivery options from Calhoun Street.
cards.short_summary: A Mediterranean bowl, wrap, and pita counter with published 9 p.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Hummus Republic lists its Cincinnati location at 257 Calhoun Street open 11 a.m.–9 p.m. daily and offering pickup, delivery, and dine-in.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 11 a.m.–9 p.m. daily; the location page lists pickup, delivery, and dine-in.

cards.title: The 86 Coffee Bar
cards.subtitle: University of Cincinnati Main Campus
cards.notes: Review UC Dining’s live hours page before visiting, since it flags special schedules; the listed regular schedule keeps this campus coffee stop open until 9 p.m.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus coffee bar with 9 p.m. regular hours.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Dining lists The 86 Coffee Bar’s regular hours as until 9 p.m. Monday–Sunday, with varying opening times by day.
cards.source_title: University of Cincinnati Dining — Hours of Operation
cards.access_notes: UC Dining lists regular closing at 9 p.m. daily; the same page notes special and break schedules, so check it before departure.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe, no-admission activities at UC and nearby public cultural and park spaces.

cards.entity_name: Dorothy W. and C. Lawson Reed, Jr. Gallery
cards.title: See a Reed Gallery exhibition
cards.subtitle: DAAP Building, UC Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Enter through DAAP’s third-floor Clifton Court entrance, then take time with the rotating exhibition on the fifth floor.
cards.short_summary: A public DAAP gallery for viewing contemporary and occasional historical exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: UC identifies the Reed Gallery as a DAAP Gallery for the university and regional public; UC materials describe Reed Gallery exhibitions as open free to the public.
cards.source_title: Reed Gallery Past Exhibits | University of Cincinnati
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours listed by UC are Sunday–Thursday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; check the current exhibition before going.

cards.entity_name: Philip M. Meyers, Jr. Memorial Gallery
cards.title: Browse the Meyers Gallery
cards.subtitle: Steger Student Life Center, UC Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Walk UC MainStreet to the Steger Student Life Center and look for the ground-floor gallery across from Nippert Stadium.
cards.short_summary: A UC gallery presenting DAAP faculty, student, and wider university work.
cards.evidence_claim: UC says the Meyers Gallery serves the university community and presents DAAP faculty and student work; UC identifies its galleries as open to everyone.
cards.access_notes: UC lists Sunday–Thursday hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; exhibitions rotate, so confirm availability first.

cards.title: Explore the permanent collection
cards.subtitle: Eden Park
cards.notes: Use free general admission to spend an afternoon with the collection, then continue on the surrounding Eden Park paths.
cards.short_summary: An art-museum visit with no general-admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Cincinnati states that Cincinnati Art Museum general admission and parking are free.
cards.source_title: The ultimate guide to Cincinnati for college students | University of Cincinnati
cards.access_notes: This applies to general admission; confirm any special-exhibition requirements directly with the museum.

cards.title: Take in contemporary art at CAC
cards.subtitle: 44 East Sixth Street, downtown Cincinnati
cards.notes: Make a self-guided lap through the galleries and pause to discuss one work that catches your group’s attention.
cards.short_summary: A downtown contemporary-art stop with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Cincinnati states that admission to the Contemporary Arts Center is free.
cards.source_title: The ultimate guide to Cincinnati for college students | University of Cincinnati
cards.access_notes: Check the center’s current visitor information for gallery availability and program-specific details.

cards.entity_name: William Howard Taft National Historic Site
cards.title: Tour Taft’s boyhood home
cards.subtitle: 2038 Auburn Avenue, Cincinnati
cards.notes: Start at the Taft Education Center, watch the orientation film, and ask a ranger about the next house tour.
cards.short_summary: A nearby National Park Service historic site with self-guided rooms and ranger tours.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service says there are no entrance fees at William Howard Taft National Historic Site or its visitor center.
cards.source_title: Fees & Passes | William Howard Taft National Historic Site
cards.access_notes: Check current operating hours; the NPS says house tours and facility access can vary by day and holiday.

cards.title: Walk Burnet Woods trails
cards.subtitle: Burnet Woods Park, adjoining UC
cards.notes: Take the open marked trails around the woods and lake; obey posted closures, including the closed lower Bard Owl Trail section.
cards.short_summary: A close-to-campus walk through a 90-acre city park with trails and a fishing lake.
cards.evidence_claim: Cincinnati Parks identifies Burnet Woods as adjoining UC with hiking trails, and states Cincinnati Parks are free for all to use.
cards.source_title: Burnet Woods & Trailside Nature Center | Cincinnati Parks
cards.access_notes: Park hours are listed as 6 a.m.–10 p.m.; follow closures and posted safety notices.

cards.title: Meet by Mirror Lake
cards.subtitle: Eden Park
cards.notes: Use the paved walkways to reach Mirror Lake, then circle the Bettman Fountain and Spring House Gazebo for an easy outdoor catch-up.
cards.short_summary: A named Eden Park landmark with paths, gardens, and nearby seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Cincinnati Parks lists Mirror Lake and the Bettman Fountain among Eden Park features and states Cincinnati Parks are free for all to use.
cards.access_notes: Eden Park is listed as open daily from 6 a.m.–10 p.m.; the lake area is outdoors and unreserved.

cards.title: Walk the Barr Labyrinth
cards.subtitle: Smale Riverfront Park, downtown Cincinnati
cards.notes: Follow the labyrinth’s path at your own pace, then continue along the riverfront on the park’s paved public spaces.
cards.short_summary: A named walkable feature in the downtown riverfront park.
cards.evidence_claim: Cincinnati Parks lists Barr Labyrinth as a Smale Riverfront Park feature and states Cincinnati Parks are free for all to use.
cards.access_notes: The park lists hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; visitors 17 and younger need a parent or guardian after 9 p.m.

cards.title: Spread out on the Civic Lawn
cards.subtitle: Washington Park, Over-the-Rhine
cards.notes: Bring a book or a conversation to the Civic Lawn, then use the park’s paved paths and free Wi‑Fi without buying anything.
cards.short_summary: A public lawn and gathering space in Washington Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Cincinnati Parks lists the Civic Lawn and free Wi‑Fi at Washington Park and states Cincinnati Parks are free for all to use.
cards.access_notes: The park lists hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; visitors 17 and younger need a parent or guardian after 9 p.m.

cards.title: Walk to the Bellevue overlook
cards.subtitle: Clifton Heights
cards.notes: Use the paved walking path and pause at the overlook for downtown and Ohio River views, keeping to the maintained park areas.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Clifton Heights park with a paved path and city-and-river viewpoint.
cards.evidence_claim: Cincinnati Parks describes Bellevue Hill Park as having a paved walking path and views of downtown Cincinnati and the Ohio River; Cincinnati Parks are free for all to use.
cards.access_notes: Use the public walking path and follow posted park rules; no reservation or purchase is needed for ordinary park use.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, officially documented University of Cincinnati study environments, from quiet library seating to reservable collaboration rooms.

cards.title: Set up in the Langsam Living Room
cards.subtitle: Walter C. Langsam Library, 4th floor
cards.notes: Choose from the fourth-floor seating and study spaces, then keep library services and the building entrance close by.
cards.short_summary: A central-library seating area on Langsam’s fourth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries identifies the Langsam Living Room on the fourth floor as providing a variety of seating and study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Located in Langsam Library; consult the library’s current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Work quietly along Langsam’s upper floors
cards.subtitle: Walter C. Langsam Library, 5th and 6th floors
cards.notes: Use the tables and desks around the borders of the fifth and sixth floors when you need a no-reservation quiet setting.
cards.short_summary: No-reservation quiet tables and desks in Langsam Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries states that quiet study spaces with tables and desks are available around the borders of Langsam’s fifth and sixth floors without reservation.
cards.access_notes: No reservation is required; library hours apply.

cards.title: Reserve Baldwin 850B for a small session
cards.subtitle: CEAS Library, Baldwin Hall
cards.notes: Book the small CEAS Library room through 25Live when a contained space will help your group focus on one task.
cards.short_summary: A reservable small-group room in the CEAS Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries lists Baldwin 850B as a small study room available through 25Live at the CEAS Library.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms | University of Cincinnati
cards.access_notes: Immediate reservation and use are handled through 25Live.

cards.title: Plan a larger table session in Baldwin 850E
cards.subtitle: CEAS Library, Baldwin Hall
cards.notes: Reserve the large CEAS Library study room in 25Live before bringing a project team or collaborative coursework meeting.
cards.short_summary: A reservable large-group room in the CEAS Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries lists Baldwin 850E as a large group study room available through 25Live at the CEAS Library.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms | University of Cincinnati
cards.access_notes: Immediate reservation and use are handled through 25Live.

cards.title: Bring a screen-based project to 5480A
cards.subtitle: DAAP Library, Aronoff Center first floor
cards.notes: Reserve this first-floor conference room through 25Live when your small group needs its monitor, PC, wireless connection, or camera.
cards.short_summary: A DAAP Library conference room with presentation and virtual-meeting technology.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries says DAAP Library’s Conference Room 5480A seats about 12 and has a monitor, PC, Solstice Pod, HDMI input, and camera.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through 25Live; the room is intended for small groups, classes, and library instruction.

cards.title: Book 6480A for a focused studio break
cards.subtitle: DAAP Library, Aronoff Center second floor
cards.notes: Reserve this sixth-floor group study room in advance for solo work or a small group that does not need built-in technology.
cards.short_summary: A reservable DAAP Library room for solo or small-group work.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries identifies 6480A as one of DAAP Library’s second-floor group study rooms, intended for solo use and small groups without technology.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through 25Live; UC’s room-reservations page states the 6000-level DAAP rooms are for current UC students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Read in the CCM Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Albino Gorno Memorial Library, College-Conservatory of Music
cards.notes: Use the Reading Room for quiet study, while checking for posted notice if a class or recital is scheduled in the space.
cards.short_summary: A community-welcoming quiet-study reading room at CCM Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries says the CCM Library Reading Room welcomes the community for quiet study, with advance notice when classes or recitals use the space.
cards.access_notes: Occasional classes or recitals may be held there; review posted notices before settling in.

cards.title: Use the CCM Library Media Lab tables
cards.subtitle: Albino Gorno Memorial Library, College-Conservatory of Music
cards.notes: Take a table in the Media Lab for quiet study, and be prepared to relocate if library instruction is scheduled there.
cards.short_summary: A CCM Library space with tables for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries states that the CCM Library Media Lab offers tables for quiet study, though instruction may occur there during the semester.
cards.access_notes: Instruction may be scheduled during the semester; advance notice is provided to readers.

cards.title: Reserve CECH Library’s adjustable-light study room
cards.subtitle: CECH Library, Teachers-Dyer 400B
cards.notes: Reserve 400B for a four-chair table, armchair, focus-tool shelf, and lighting whose brightness and color temperature can be adjusted.
cards.short_summary: A UC-community reservable CECH Library room with adjustable lighting.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries says Teachers-Dyer 400B has a table with four chairs, an armchair, adjustable lighting, and study and focus tools, and is reservable by the UC community.
cards.access_notes: Reservable by the UC community; use the library’s reservation link for availability.

cards.title: Check whether MakerLab 325 is open for study
cards.subtitle: CECH Library, room 325
cards.notes: Use MakerLab’s four tables and projector for study or making when no class or reservation is underway; check regular library hours.
cards.short_summary: A flexible CECH Library study-and-making room with four tables.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Libraries states that MakerLab 325 has four tables and a projector and is available as open study when it is not reserved or hosting a class.
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; it may be reserved for instruction or UC-affiliated purposes.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named corridors on or immediately beside UC’s Uptown campus, each paired with a map-listed destination or documented public place.

cards.title: Calhoun Street — U Square
cards.subtitle: Calhoun Street corridor; U Square at 225–255 Calhoun St.
cards.notes: Start at U Square and use its public-facing Calhoun Street frontage as an easy landmark opposite UC’s main campus.
cards.short_summary: A Calhoun Street stop anchored by U Square’s dining, entertainment, and classroom complex.
cards.evidence_claim: UC identifies U Square on Calhoun Street, directly across from its main campus, with dining and entertainment establishments below the residences.
cards.access_notes: Use public street-level areas; individual businesses and university offices set their own access rules.

cards.title: Short Vine — Bearcat Statue
cards.subtitle: Short Vine corridor; Bearcat statue in Corryville
cards.notes: Look for the eight-foot Bearcat statue along Short Vine, then continue on the public corridor toward its storefronts.
cards.short_summary: A documented UC-themed public artwork gives this Short Vine walk a clear visual marker.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Magazine reports that an eight-foot University of Cincinnati Bearcat statue greets passersby along Short Vine in Corryville.
cards.source_title: Short Vine unveils Bearcat statue | University of Cincinnati
cards.access_notes: View the outdoor artwork from the public right-of-way; respect adjacent business and event access policies.

cards.title: McMillan Street — UC Alumni Association
cards.subtitle: McMillan Street corridor; UC Alumni Association on the UC map
cards.notes: Use the UC Alumni Association marker as a map-reading waypoint where McMillan Street meets the south side of campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus-map landmark on McMillan Street for orienting a south-edge walk.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s West Campus map labels McMillan Street and the UC Alumni Association at the campus’s south edge.
cards.source_title: UC Maps and Directions | University of Cincinnati
cards.access_notes: Follow public sidewalks; alumni-association building access may be limited to scheduled or posted hours.

cards.title: Ohio Avenue — Bellevue Hill Park
cards.subtitle: Ohio Avenue corridor; Bellevue Hill Park off Ohio Street
cards.notes: Take Ohio Avenue to Bellevue Hill Park and use the green space for a daytime pause or a self-guided neighborhood walk.
cards.short_summary: A nearby public-park detour specifically located off Ohio Street by UC.
cards.evidence_claim: UC identifies Bellevue Hill Park as a nearby green space located off Ohio Street and cites it as a setting for free yoga classes.
cards.source_title: UC student leaders seek better student-neighbor relations | University of Cincinnati
cards.access_notes: Park access is outdoors; check City of Cincinnati notices for any event-specific or seasonal restrictions.

cards.title: Dennis Street — Pringle Park
cards.subtitle: Dennis Street corridor; Pringle Park off Dennis Street
cards.notes: Use Dennis Street as the approach to Pringle Park for a short outdoor stop, then return by the same public corridor.
cards.short_summary: A green-space destination documented just off Dennis Street near UC.
cards.evidence_claim: UC identifies Pringle Park as a nearby green space located off Dennis Street and cites it as a potential site for free yoga classes.
cards.source_title: UC student leaders seek better student-neighbor relations | University of Cincinnati
cards.access_notes: Park access is outdoors; check City of Cincinnati notices for any event-specific or seasonal restrictions.

cards.title: Scioto Street — Scioto Hall
cards.subtitle: Scioto Street corridor; Scioto Hall at 2921 Scioto Lane
cards.notes: Use the Scioto Hall address as a precise south-campus waypoint while following the public portion of the Scioto Street corridor.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed residential landmark beside Scioto Street.
cards.evidence_claim: UC lists Scioto Hall at 2921 Scioto Lane, and its West Campus map labels both Scioto Street and Scioto Hall.
cards.access_notes: Use public sidewalks only; Scioto Hall is a residential building and is not general public indoor access.

cards.title: Corbett Drive — Siddall Hall
cards.subtitle: Corbett Drive corridor; Siddall Hall at 2540 Corbett Drive
cards.notes: Follow Corbett Drive to the clearly addressed Siddall Hall, using the residence-hall frontage as a south-edge orientation point.
cards.short_summary: A direct-address landmark along Corbett Drive near the UC boundary.
cards.evidence_claim: UC lists Siddall Hall at 2540 Corbett Drive, and its West Campus map labels Corbett Drive and Siddall Hall.
cards.access_notes: Use public sidewalks only; Siddall Hall is a residential building and indoor entry is restricted.

cards.title: Jefferson Avenue — Corry Garage
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Avenue corridor; Corry Garage at Corry Boulevard
cards.notes: Use Jefferson Avenue to locate the Corry Garage at Corry Boulevard when orienting between the campus edge and Short Vine.
cards.short_summary: A practical map-listed garage landmark at the Jefferson Avenue approach to Corry Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s campus map places Jefferson Avenue beside Corry Boulevard and labels Corry Garage at that campus-edge area.
cards.source_title: Uptown West Campus Map | University of Cincinnati
cards.access_notes: This is a navigation landmark; garage entry and parking require compliance with UC Parking rules and posted restrictions.

cards.title: Straight Street — Blegen Library
cards.subtitle: Straight Street corridor; Blegen Library on the campus edge
cards.notes: Use Straight Street to find Blegen Library on the map, then confirm current library visitor access before entering for research.
cards.short_summary: A named campus-edge corridor paired with UC’s Blegen Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s West Campus map labels Straight Street and Blegen Library together along the campus’s southwest edge.
cards.source_title: Uptown West Campus Map | University of Cincinnati
cards.access_notes: Check UC Libraries’ current visitor and building-access policies before planning an indoor visit.

cards.title: West Clifton Avenue — Hughes High School
cards.subtitle: West Clifton Avenue corridor; Hughes High School on the UC map
cards.notes: Walk the public West Clifton Avenue corridor and use Hughes High School as a visible map-listed landmark near Calhoun Street.
cards.short_summary: A public-street route marked by a named school building on UC’s south edge.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s West Campus map labels West Clifton Avenue and Hughes High School near Calhoun Street and U Square.
cards.source_title: Uptown West Campus Map | University of Cincinnati
cards.access_notes: Stay on public sidewalks; school grounds and interior access are controlled by Cincinnati Public Schools.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Bearcat gameday and campus-spirit traditions, drawn from UC’s admissions, alumni, and band sources.

cards.title: Learn Down the Drive
cards.subtitle: Bearcat spirit tradition
cards.notes: Watch UC’s official demonstration, then join the movement only where event organizers invite participation.
cards.short_summary: A UC admissions page calls Down the Drive one of the community’s cherished Bearcats traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Admissions identifies Down the Drive as a cherished Bearcats tradition and provides an official instructional video.
cards.access_notes: UC provides a video and social-media audio for learning the tradition; check event guidance before participating.

cards.title: Wear Black at a “Wear Black” Game
cards.subtitle: Nippert Stadium football tradition
cards.notes: For a designated wear-black game, dress in black and follow the current game’s official color instructions.
cards.short_summary: UC’s student-alumni guide documents dressing in all black for special football games.
cards.evidence_claim: The UC Student Alumni Council’s Red & Black Book describes dressing in all black as a tradition highlighted during special wear-black games.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: Applies to specially designated football games; confirm the current game’s theme through UC Athletics or university channels.

cards.title: Make Room for the Band’s Step Rush
cards.subtitle: Nippert Stadium pregame
cards.notes: Use the marked routes and give the musicians space as the band descends into its pregame entrance.
cards.short_summary: The marching band’s rush down the Nippert steps is a documented pregame tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s Red & Black Book says the Bearcat Marching Band rushes down the steps once the student section is filled.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: Pregame at Nippert Stadium; spectators should follow staff directions and keep clear of the band’s route.

cards.title: Time the N-A-T-I Shout
cards.subtitle: Football kickoff call-and-response
cards.notes: Listen for the kickoff and join the N-A-T-I shout before the first ball is caught, if you choose to participate.
cards.short_summary: Fans use a spelled-out N-A-T-I shout at the opening of a football kickoff.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s Red & Black Book states that students and fans shout “N-A-T-I” before the first ball is caught after kickoff.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: Occurs during football games; follow stadium policies and announcements.

cards.title: Count the ROTC Score Push-Ups
cards.subtitle: Football scoring tradition
cards.notes: After a Bearcats score, watch the cadets’ push-up count and cheer from your seat or designated viewing area.
cards.short_summary: ROTC cadets perform a push-up for each Bearcats point during football games.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s Red & Black Book says ROTC cadets do one push-up for every point scored by the Bearcats.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: A football-game tradition performed by ROTC cadets; spectators can observe and count along.

cards.title: Sing “Cheer Cincinnati”
cards.subtitle: Bearcats fight song
cards.notes: Use the official lyrics to follow the song at a game or spirit event, keeping pace with the band and crowd.
cards.short_summary: Cheer Cincinnati is UC’s documented Bearcats fight song and a gameday singalong.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s Red & Black Book prints the lyrics to “Cheer Cincinnati” and identifies it among football gameday traditions.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: Commonly performed in athletics settings; follow the event program for timing.

cards.title: Stay for the Alma Mater
cards.subtitle: Postgame Bearcats tradition
cards.notes: At the end of a Bearcats game, remain through the closing song and sing along using UC’s published words.
cards.short_summary: UC’s student-alumni guide says a game is not over until the Alma Mater is sung.
cards.evidence_claim: The Red & Black Book says Bearcats fans stay until the end and that the game is not over until the Alma Mater is sung.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: Postgame tradition across Bearcats sports; timing depends on the event schedule.

cards.title: Watch the Walk Through at The Grid
cards.subtitle: Sigma Sigma Commons football pregame
cards.notes: Arrive early for the scheduled pregame walk-through and use the commons respectfully alongside the larger crowd.
cards.short_summary: The Grid tailgate brings together alumni and students before home football games.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s Red & Black Book identifies the GRIDiron Tailgate on Sigma Sigma Commons before each home football game and notes the teams’ walk-through.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: Before home football games at Sigma Sigma Commons; check current gameday details for event arrangements.

cards.title: Wait for the First Basket
cards.subtitle: Fifth Third Arena basketball tradition
cards.notes: If materials are provided for the tradition, wait for the first Bearcats score and follow arena cleanup guidance.
cards.short_summary: The Red & Black Book documents a newspaper confetti toss after the first Bearcats basket.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s Red & Black Book instructs students to use an old News Record for a confetti toss after the first Bearcats score at basketball games.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: At Fifth Third Arena basketball games; participate only as permitted by current arena staff and policies.

cards.title: Wear Red and Black on Friday
cards.subtitle: Weekly Bearcat spirit practice
cards.notes: Choose red-and-black Bearcat gear on Friday to take part in the campus spirit practice documented by UC students.
cards.short_summary: UC’s student-alumni guide describes Friday red-and-black Bearcat gear as a campus spirit practice.
cards.evidence_claim: The Red & Black Book says UC students wear Bearcat gear every Friday and encourages dressing in red and black.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: A Friday spirit practice, regardless of season; no event attendance is required.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Cincinnati, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend sequence that starts with campus orientation, adds ways to connect, and leaves room for nearby culture and outdoors time.

cards.title: Start with the self-guided campus route
cards.subtitle: Set your bearings on Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Use UC’s self-guided route and maps to choose a few buildings you will actually revisit, then save the route for your next errand run.
cards.short_summary: A flexible first lap that turns the campus map into familiar ground.
cards.evidence_claim: UC invites visitors to explore campus at their own pace and provides a self-guided tour route and maps.
cards.access_notes: A printed route is available from the Admissions Welcome Desk on the third floor of University Pavilion.

cards.title: Make the Fighting Bearcat your meet-up landmark
cards.subtitle: Commons Way, outside Marian Spencer Hall
cards.notes: Walk over for a daylight photo and pick a simple meeting point nearby; the sculpture now stands at West University Avenue and Commons Way.
cards.short_summary: A documented campus sculpture and easy visual anchor for your new routes.
cards.evidence_claim: UC reinstalled the 15-foot Fighting Bearcat sculpture on Commons Way outside Marian Spencer Hall in April 2026.
cards.source_title: UC reinstalls Bearcat sculpture in time for commencement
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public artwork; visit during normal campus access hours.

cards.title: Save two events in GetInvolvedUC
cards.subtitle: UC’s student organization and event portal
cards.notes: Filter for an interest you already have, then save two events or organizations so you have a concrete option when the weekend plans shift.
cards.short_summary: An online starting point for finding campus events and registered student organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: UC describes GetInvolvedUC as its online community for discovering campus events and joining registered student organizations.
cards.access_notes: Sign in or browse the organization directory through UC’s portal.

cards.title: Try one corner of the Campus Rec Center
cards.subtitle: 2820 Bearcat Way
cards.notes: Bring your Bearcat Card and choose one manageable activity, such as the pool, climbing wall, basketball court, or a fitness-floor orientation.
cards.short_summary: A large on-campus recreation facility with multiple activity options.
cards.evidence_claim: UC lists fitness equipment, pools, a climbing wall, basketball courts, intramurals, and fitness-floor orientations at the Campus Recreation Center.
cards.access_notes: Membership is included in the Campus Life fee for full-time Main Campus students; other memberships may require purchase.

cards.title: Find a study spot before you need one
cards.subtitle: 2911 Woodside Drive
cards.notes: Walk through the fourth-floor living room and the quiet fifth- and sixth-floor areas, then note a backup spot for your first busy week.
cards.short_summary: UC’s central library offers common, quiet, and reservable study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Langsam Library provides common areas, no-reservation quiet study spaces, and group study rooms reservable by current UC students.
cards.source_title: Walter C. Langsam Library | University of Cincinnati Libraries
cards.access_notes: Entering after The Desk closes requires UC affiliation and a Bearcat Card or photo ID.

cards.entity_name: Philip M. Meyers, Jr. Memorial Gallery
cards.title: Check the current show at Meyers Gallery
cards.subtitle: Steger Student Life Center, across from Nippert Stadium
cards.notes: Step into the ground-floor gallery while crossing Main Street, read the exhibition label, and make a note of one work to revisit with a friend.
cards.short_summary: A student-life-hub gallery presenting changing exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: UC says the Meyers Gallery hosts exhibitions and is located on the ground floor of Steger Student Life Center across from Nippert Stadium.
cards.access_notes: UC lists visiting hours as Sunday through Thursday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; exhibitions rotate.

cards.title: Pause at Nippert Stadium between plans
cards.subtitle: Carson Field at the center of campus
cards.notes: Take the pedestrian route past the stadium and look for its brick and wrought-iron details; check the Athletics calendar separately before planning a game.
cards.short_summary: A campus-centered football venue with a long documented history.
cards.evidence_claim: UC identifies Nippert Stadium as the Bearcats football home since 1901 and describes its brickwork and wrought-iron gates.
cards.source_title: UC in the Big XII | University of Cincinnati
cards.access_notes: View exterior and campus paths freely; event entry and stadium access depend on the event.

cards.title: Locate Fifth Third Arena for future game nights
cards.subtitle: 2700 O’Varsity Way, Varsity Village
cards.notes: Walk by the arena exterior after Nippert and save its location in your map app, so you can recognize the route when an event interests you.
cards.short_summary: A named Varsity Village venue on UC’s West Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s campus directory lists Fifth Third Arena, Myrl H. Shoemaker Center, at 2700 O’Varsity Way on West Campus.
cards.source_title: Fifth Third Arena, Myrl H. Shoemaker Center | UC Campus Buildings
cards.access_notes: This card is for locating the venue exterior; entry and ticket requirements vary by event.

cards.title: Take a daylight reset at Burnet Woods
cards.subtitle: 3251 Brookline Avenue, adjoining UC
cards.notes: Choose the paved walks or open areas for a short daytime loop, and follow posted closures rather than entering any restricted trail sections.
cards.short_summary: A 90-acre city park beside UC with trails, a lake, and picnic areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Cincinnati Parks says Burnet Woods adjoins UC and includes hiking trails, a fishing lake, a historic bandstand, and other park amenities.
cards.source_title: Burnet Woods & Trailside Nature Center | Cincinnati Parks
cards.access_notes: Cincinnati Parks lists park hours as 6 a.m.–10 p.m.; a portion of the Bard Owl Trail is currently closed for safety.

cards.title: Finish with a free museum afternoon
cards.subtitle: 953 Eden Park Drive, Cincinnati
cards.notes: Use free general admission to explore the permanent collection, then confirm whether any temporary exhibition you want to see needs a separate ticket.
cards.short_summary: A city art museum where general admission is free every day.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cincinnati Art Museum states that general admission is always free, while exhibition ticket pricing can vary.
cards.access_notes: General admission is free; check the museum’s current hours and exhibition ticket requirements before traveling.
